WITH matched AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, s.insurstat
  FROM scanconservation AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), counts AS (
  SELECT zoneref, insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count,
         COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS record_fraction
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY zoneref, insurstat
)
SELECT zoneref, insurstat, record_count, record_fraction
FROM counts
ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, insurstat NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
